==Usage==
For article titles that have been anglicized instead of translated, include the parameter "ang" with any value:
<pre>{{ConjectureTranslation|ang=1}}</pre>
<br />
For article titles that have been both anglicized and translated, include the parameter "both" with any value:
<pre>{{ConjectureTranslation|both=1}}</pre>
